entry.summary:
RT Filecoin .@Lilypad_Tech supports Qwen3-14B, an open-weight model trained with an advanced tokenizer and alignment methods. It offers strong multilingual and instruction-following abilities, 128K context length, and runs fully on decentralized compute for RAG, agents, and document tasks.
Lilypad Network: And just like that, Qwen3-14b is now supported by the Lilypad API! 🚀 Check out our API docs and learn how to get started: https://docs.lilypad.tech/lilypad/developer-resources/inference-api
